CustomField.label: Advanced: Expected Display Value
CustomField.description: Optional. Used only when Check Type is Check fields on this record. A formula whose result is shown as the "Expected" value on the result row (the right side of a comparison — what the record should have had). Leave blank to keep the default behavior (the row shows a "Passes when" line echoing the Pass Condition (Formula) text). The Pass Condition (Formula) still decides pass/fail. Example: BLANKVALUE(Credit_Total__c, 0) - BLANKVALUE(Adjustment__c, 0).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Formula shown as "Expected" on the row (e.g. BLANKVALUE(Credit_Total__c, 0)). Pass/fail is still decided by Pass Condition (Formula). Blank = the row shows a "Passes when" line with the formula text.
